notes.subject: עקב
notes.rationale: Literal 'heel' used adverbially: 'unto the end' (KJV) vs 'at every step' (JPS); Tok Pisin takes 'unto the end'.

notes.subject: הורני
notes.rationale: Root ירה means 'flow as water / throw / point' — teaching as shooting straight; flattened to 'skulim'.

notes.subject: to Yahwe
notes.rationale: Direct address to Yahwe in the opening petition.

notes.subject: skulim mi
notes.rationale: Imperative petition draws speaker into the way of the statutes.

translation: Yahwe, skulim mi long rot bilong ol lo bilong yu, na bai mi lukautim ⟨em⟩ i go inap long taim olgeta.
